description: Assess backlog health: high/low priority ratio, open ticket count, total cost, and the stale tickets: open ones whose scores haven't changed for staleDays (a change of title, description or tags doesn't count), oldest first, worth re-scoring. highToLowRatio is null when no open ticket is low priority, also when there are no open tickets.

staleDays.description: Days without a change of scores after which an open ticket counts as stale (default 90)

threshold.description: High priority threshold, greater than 0 (default 1.5), compared with the exact value/cost, not the rounded priority

name: report_health

staleTickets.description: Open tickets not re-scored for staleDays, oldest first

scoredAt.description: When its scores last changed, or it was created
